name: Belmond Reid's Palace
positioning: Belmond's clifftop hotel in Funchal, Madeira, opened in 1891, with sea access and three outdoor pools (official name Reid's Palace)
best_for: Travelers who want a historic Atlantic clifftop hotel with sea access
Families, since the hotel has a kids' club and pet-friendly amenities

facts.text: Reid's Palace stands in Funchal, Madeira, above the Atlantic Ocean.
Belmond took over the hotel in 1996.
The hotel has three outdoor swimming pools.
Maré Spa offers regional treatments using aloe vera balsam and grapeseed oil.
The grounds include subtropical gardens, and guests can book a garden tour.
Ristorante Villa Cipriani serves casual dinner on its terrace.
Classic afternoon tea is held on a black-and-white checkered terrace.
The hotel has a kids' club called Fun@Reid's.
Bathrooms have tubs and showers and soaps from the Portuguese brand Claus Porto.

highlights.text: A saltwater pool sits at ocean level, reached by a cliff-hugging lift.
Early guests who arrived by boat were carried up the cliff in hammocks.
Interiors include Portuguese tiles and vintage photographs of Winston Churchill at a typewriter.
The hotel was opened by the Reid family in 1891.
The hotel has direct access to the sea.

considerations.text: The hotel is a 10-minute drive from central Funchal.
Afternoon tea is normally fully booked with outside guests, so guests should secure a spot in advance with the front desk.
There is one accessible room and a few ramps, but some elevators are too small for wheelchair access.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Belmond Reid's Palace
